body.name: branchwise expected-length vector
body.construction: \(\mathcal L_n(C_n)=(L_G(C_n),L_N(C_n))\), where \(L_G(C_n)=\sup_{P\in\mathcal G_n:(\widehat g,\widehat q)\in\mathcal H_n(P)}E_{Q_P}|C_n|\) and \(L_N(C_n)=\sup_{P\in\mathcal N_n(\delta_n):(\widehat g,\widehat q)\in\mathcal H_n(P)}E_{Q_P}|C_n|\).
